info.title: passbolt
info.description: Cross-platform command-line client for the Passbolt password manager, built on the Passbolt.Api .NET client. Installable as a .NET global tool (dotnet tool install -g Passbolt.Cli). Read, list and audit Passbolt resources, users, groups, folders and permissions — including an ownership audit that flags resources with fewer than two owners or no group owner.
